name: Blockchain & smart contract development
short: Solidity smart contracts, dApps and wallet integrations.
metaTitle: Freelance Blockchain Developer for Hire | Nishchal KC
metaDescription: Hire a freelance blockchain engineer for Solidity smart contracts, dApps, MetaMask sign-in and IPFS storage. Clear process, tested code, clients worldwide.
lead: I'm Nishchal KC, a blockchain engineer who writes Solidity smart contracts and builds the web apps around them, so the on-chain part and the part people actually use are made by one person.
forWho: Founders and teams who need on-chain logic, such as voting, verification or tamper-proof records
Businesses exploring blockchain who want a working proof of concept, not a slide deck
Developers and agencies who need a contract plus a front-end to go with it
deliverables: Solidity smart contracts for Ethereum and EVM-compatible networks
dApp front-ends with wallet sign-in through MetaMask
Document and file storage on IPFS, using services such as Pinata
Contract testing before anything is deployed to a live network
Containerised setups with Docker so the project is easy to run and move
Clear handover: code, setup notes and a walkthrough

process.d: We agree what the contract must do, who uses it and what counts as success. I write this down as a short brief you approve.
I sketch the contract's functions, roles and data, and how the front-end talks to it, before writing the final code.
I write the contract and the app together, and test the contract on a test network with regular check-ins.
Deploy, hand over the code and notes, and stay available for fixes after launch.

faq.q: What can a smart contract do for my project?
faq.a: A smart contract is code that runs on a blockchain and follows rules nobody can quietly change. It suits things that need a shared, auditable record, such as votes, certificates, ownership or payments between parties who do not fully trust each other. If your project does not need that, I will tell you, and a normal web app will serve you better.

faq.q: Which blockchains do you work with?
faq.a: My experience is with Ethereum and Solidity, which also covers other EVM-compatible networks.

faq.q: Do you test contracts before they go live?
faq.a: Yes. Contract testing is part of every build, and contracts are deployed to a test network first. For contracts that will hold significant value, I recommend an independent professional security audit as well.

faq.q: Can you also build the website or app around the contract?
faq.a: Yes. I build the front-end in React and TypeScript, including wallet sign-in, so you get the whole product from one person.

faq.q: How long will it take and what will it cost?
faq.a: It depends on how many functions, roles and screens the project needs. Send me a short description and I will reply with a scoped plan and an estimate.
